title: Fool Moon
author: Jim Butcher
summary: Harry Dresden is a wizard who works as a private investigator in modern Chicago. In this second case, a string of brutal killings points to werewolves, and he finds himself caught between the police and several dangerous factions.
readIf: you like wisecracking urban fantasy that moves like a detective novel.
skipIf: you dislike gory violence, or want a series that is slow and atmospheric.

pairings.reason: Also fuses fantasy with a proper detective story, with a sharp investigator and a strange magical setting.
A hidden magical London under the real one, with a lighter, more dreamlike touch.
A straight private-detective series for when you want the case without the magic.
